basis: Published BPA blood pharmacokinetics: biphasic elimination, t½₁=2 h and t½₂=9 h (midpoints of the reviewed 0.7–3.7 h and 7.2–12.0 h ranges — Kashino/Kageji critical review of human 10B-BPA kinetics); end-of-infusion level 24.4 µg/g (Savolainen et al., Acta Oncol, mean over the FiR 1 glioma series).
